Running the official blockwise accumulator verbatim (batch 8192, abs(), triu(1) on diagonal blocks, float64) against BLME's exact all-pairs path: gpt2 official 0.0746565427 vs BLME 0.0746565387 (rel 5.42e-08), pythia-70m 0.8430953325 vs 0.8430953026 (rel 3.55e-08). normalized_ok_detail: Unchanged by this round and still verified: 4,000 iid Gaussian rows give overlap_vs_random 1.00034 (m=32), 0.99965 (m=64), 0.99975 (m=256), and on the 66-model snapshot the d_model association drops from rho -0.574 (p=4.6e-7) to -0.205 (p=0.099). superposition_ratio is NOT the clean one (its random-unit-vector expectation is (V-1)/(V-m), not 1).

Re-ran its blockwise all-pairs accumulator verbatim against BLME's exact path: gpt2 rel 5.42e-08, pythia-70m rel 3.55e-08. paper_reason: Liu, Liu & Gore's own null, E[cos^2] = 1/m for isotropic unit vectors, reproduces: 4,000 seeded Gaussian rows give 0.03126063 at m=32 (published 1/32 = 0.03125, 0.034% rel), 0.01561946 at m=64 (0.036%), 0.00390529 at m=256 (0.025%). The Welch-bound anchor (simplex ETF of V=m+1 attains cos^2 = 1/m^2) reproduces exactly with ratio 1.000000.
confounds_reason: Raw mean_squared_overlap is dimension-determined under the source's own null (exactly 1/m on Gaussian controls; rho -0.574 with d_model over 66 models). overlap_vs_random removes most of it (-0.205, n.s.) but keeps a modest n_layers association (-0.293, p=0.017). Note also that mean squared overlap alone does not IDENTIFY learned superposition: an untrained isotropic head scores overlap_vs_random ~ 1.000 by geometry alone, so only the deviation from 1 is evidence.
defects: Cosmetic: n_zero_rows is computed at superposition_strength.py:75 and never used. Emit it as _meta_n_zero_rows so the dropped-row count is auditable, or delete it.

mean_squared_overlap_centered drops zero-norm rows of the CENTERED matrix (count V_c) but is divided by welch_bound(V_eff, m) computed from the RAW matrix. Welch is increasing in V, so if V_c < V_eff the centered ratio can dip below 1. Requires a row exactly equal to the column mean, so unreachable on real heads, but the two counts should be made consistent.
The shipped max_pairs=200,000 Monte-Carlo estimate carries 1.5e-3 relative error on gpt2 and no error bar is reported (CONFIG-level, immaterial downstream).
